body.text: Why is Gaziantep one of the world's largest machine-made carpet and food-processing export hubs?

Gaziantep combines vertically integrated polypropylene yarn extrusion, high-speed carpet weaving looms, industrial-scale pasta and biscuit lines, and woven PP sack manufacturing in a single inland cluster. According to the [Southeastern Anatolia Exporters' Association (GAİB)](https://www.gaib.org.tr/tr/hali/genel-sayfa/kurumsal/hakkimizda-20.html), around 200 regional producers operate over 1,500 looms and account for 90% of Türkiye's machine-made carpet exports.

Türkiye's total carpet exports reached roughly $2.84 billion in 2025, with [GAİB](https://www.gaib.org.tr/en/general-page/corporate/about-us-1.html) members generating 69.1% of national volume across 144 countries, led by the United States, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, the United Kingdom, and Germany. Beyond flooring, Gaziantep's food processors rank among Türkiye's top exporters of durum pasta, bulgur, confectionery, sunflower oil, and Antep pistachios, backed by domestic packaging plants producing FIBC big bags and laminated food films.
How do you navigate Gaziantep Organized Industrial Zones (GAOSB)?

Gaziantep Organized Industrial Zone ([GAOSB](https://www.gaosb.org/)) spans five contiguous numbered industrial zones north of Şehitkamil along the Tarsus–Adana–Gaziantep (TAG) motorway, plus newer expansions and the airport-adjacent Oğuzeli OIZ documented by the [Gaziantep Chamber of Industry (GSO)](https://gso.org.tr/en/general-page/the-industry-of-gaziantep/industrial-zones-56.html). Because plants sit across sprawling numbered avenues, buyers need pre-confirmed gate clearances, exact street coordinates, and a local driver.

items: Gate & address precision: Confirm exact GAOSB street numbers (83xxx Nolu Cadde) and visitor pass rules 48 hours ahead.
Sample verification: Check carpet pile weight (g/m²), point density per square meter, backing latex quality, and OEKO-TEX or ISO 9001 certificates on site.
Food & packaging audits: Inspect BRCGS, ISO 22000, or Halal certificates and finished-goods warehouse storage conditions.

body.text: What flight and hotel logistics work for a 2-day executive visit?

Fly directly from Istanbul Airport (IST) or Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) into [Gaziantep Airport (GZT)](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Gaziantep/GenelBilgiler.aspx), operated 24 hours by DHMİ in Oğuzeli roughly 25 minutes from the city center. Book an early Day 1 arrival, base yourself in Şehitkamil's business hotel district, and depart on a late Day 2 evening flight to complete four to five thorough factory visits.

Two-day executive trips to Gaziantep pair well with western industrial stops such as Istanbul or [Bursa](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/destinations/bursa) on the same week-long Türkiye sourcing itinerary. Staying in Şehitkamil puts you on the northern side of town with direct access to the GAOSB highway, avoiding slow cross-city traffic.
Where do you host supplier dinners in Gaziantep?

Gaziantep holds official recognition in the [UNESCO Creative Cities Network for Gastronomy](https://www.unesco.org/en/creative-cities/gaziantep), making supplier dinners a central part of local business culture. For quiet executive discussions, choose established Şehitkamil dining rooms or restored historic courtyard restaurants near the castle district that offer private tables, attentive service, and regional specialties such as yuvalama, küşleme, and pistachio baklava.

In Gaziantep, business relationships are personal and family-led. Expect generous hospitality from factory owners—and reciprocate by reserving a calm, high-standard venue where technical terms and next steps can be reviewed comfortably without loud music.

faq.q: How far is GAOSB from Gaziantep Airport (GZT)?
faq.a: Driving from Gaziantep Airport (GZT) to the main GAOSB zones takes roughly 35 to 45 minutes via the ring road and TAG motorway, depending on rush-hour truck volume.

faq.q: Can international buyers order custom carpet designs and sizes in Gaziantep?
faq.a: Yes. Most export-oriented GAOSB mills run computerized Jacquard looms capable of custom colorways, private-label backing tags, and retail-ready roll or folded-pack formats, subject to per-design square-meter minimums.

faq.q: Which ports do Gaziantep exporters use for ocean freight?
faq.a: Gaziantep factories typically truck containers 2.5 to 3.5 hours southwest to İskenderun or Mersin ports on the Mediterranean coast for onward shipments to Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas.

faq.q: Do factory managers in GAOSB speak English?
faq.a: Export managers at major carpet and food plants usually speak fluent English, though technical loom supervisors and production-line heads often speak Turkish, making an independent interpreter valuable during shop-floor audits.

faq.q: Is two days enough to visit both carpet and packaging suppliers in Gaziantep?
faq.a: Yes, if appointments are clustered by OIZ zone. Plan two to three factories per day with pre-confirmed gate access and a dedicated local driver.
